items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: I was born right here on Conti, between Dauphin and Bourbon, right where Bruce Oswald's Restore.

ctx.x: I was wondering, which part of the town were you raised in? Where were you born?

I was born right here on Conti, between Dauphin and Bourbon, right where Bruce Oswald's Restore. Right there? Yes, right in the backyard I was born. Were you raised in there? I was raised all the way, I was left there in 1900. And my father went in the business on Orleans and Billory and I was around the Fifth Ward all my life. Raised in the Fifth Ward. And I was raised around a lot of colored musicians. I mean the way all the colored musicians lived in the Fifth Ward, most of them. Most of them. Every one of…
Well, how old were you when you could first go in the district?
